market_definition: The Global Antioxidants Market covers chemical antioxidant additives used in rubber, elastomers, plastics and polymer formulations to prevent oxidative degradation during processing and service life: aromatic amine, hindered phenolic, phosphite and phosphonite, thioester and other antioxidants, in powder, liquid, flake, pellet / granule and pre-dispersed / emulsified forms, for natural rubber, SBR, BR, NBR, ABS, latex, thermoplastic elastomers and other polymers, used in tires and tire components, industrial rubber products, rubber and latex gloves, foams, adhesives and tapes, plastic and polymer compounding and wire and cable, for heat and thermal-oxidation protection, processing stability, long-term aging, ozone / weathering protection and color retention, across automotive, industrial, healthcare, construction, electrical and electronics and consumer products, sold direct and through distributors.
